name: Goldpool

abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Goldpool için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Double Regen = Double Fun
Once per fight, Goldpool gains Regeneration, recovering [11,626.4 - 38,396.81] Health over 8 seconds. If this ability is suppressed by a Skill Champion, Goldpool reaches into his script code and tries once more to activate it after 2 seconds. Mutant beats Trained...I mean...Skill

abilitySections.title: Land 20 Hits Without Being Struck
content: Goldpool's confidence soars and he begins throwing out childish barbs to annoy his opponent, inflicting a Taunt passive on them for 10 seconds, reducing their Attack Rating by 35%. Childish!? Hey! Words hurt!

abilitySections.title: When brought below 15% Max Health
content: Once per fight, Goldpool has a 999% chance to gain Regeneration, recovering [29,066] Health over 8 seconds. Leave my Regen alone Black Widow! You too Crossbones!

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: A boot to the face is always funny, and allows Goldpool to refresh a personal Taunt effect. Pow! Right in the...well...

abilitySections.title: Bleed Effects
content: Goldpool's accelerated healing factor reduces the damage of incoming Bleed effects by 20%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 65% chance to Stun the opponent for 2 seconds. Against Non-Robot Male Champions, this chance is doubled. Cup Check!

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If Goldpool completes his dance after this attack he gains Prowess, increasing Special Attack damage by 100% for 40 seconds. If he is interrupted he instead gains 25% Power. Dance break!
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [17,262.3] direct damage over 5.5 seconds. This Bleed is affected by Prowess Buffs.
25% chance to Stun the opponent for 3 seconds. The first time this attack is used each fight, the chance is 100%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Goldpool receives a call from the game devs, and then annoys them into Refreshing his Prowess and Regeneration Buffs.
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [28,247.4] direct damage over 4.5 seconds. This Bleed is affected by Prowess Buffs.
